channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula diz que país não aceita 'político vira-lata que fica de quatro para os EUA'
item.description: At a rally in Ceilândia, Lula criticized candidates who act like stray dogs toward the US, reinforcing a national independence and anti-imperialist stance. He argued that Brazil does not accept politicians subordinated to foreign interests.

item.title: Lula pede voto para Zé Dirceu à Câmara dos Deputados e fala em 'reparação histórica'
item.description: President Lula recorded a video endorsing Zé Dirceu for the Chamber of Deputies and emphasized 'historical reparation' for the former Chief of Staff. The post was published on Dirceu's Instagram account during the 2026 election cycle.

item.title: Lula: quem quebrou o BRB foi ligação entre Ibaneis e Vorcaro; não vamos dar dinheiro para o BRB
item.description: President Lula accused former DF governor Ibaneis Rocha of harming Banco de Brasília (BRB) due to his connection with Daniel Vorcaro, ex-owner of Banco Master, during a rally in Ceilândia. Lula stated he will not allocate funds to BRB, reinforcing criticism of the prior administration.

item.title: TSE proíbe Lucas Bove de usar santinhos com imagem de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court issued a preliminary injunction prohibiting Lucas Bove (PL-SP) from using campaign leaflets featuring the image of Jair Bolsonaro. The ban was decided on Wednesday, 16th, and the space remains open for the candidate's manifestation.

item.title: Lula chama governadora do DF de cínica e diz que governo federal não vai dar dinheiro para o BRB
item.description: President Lula called the DF governor, Celina Leão, cynical and stated that the federal government will not provide funds for the financial recovery of Banco de Brasília.

item.title: A reação do governo Lula às críticas de Trump sobre combate ao PCC e ao CV
item.description: The Brazilian government, through the Ministry of Justice, rejected criticisms from U.S. President Donald Trump, asserting that Brazil has effectively combated organized crime, citing laws like the Anti-Gang Law and joint operations. Trump labeled the PCC and Red Command as global threats and demanded stronger actions, but Brazil highlighted existing international cooperation and initiatives such as the Brazil Against Organized Crime Program.

item.title: "Bolsonara de Ceilândia", diz Janja ao criticar candidatura de Michelle
item.description: Janja criticized Michelle Bolsonaro's candidacy, urging voters to avoid supporting people with the Bolsonaro surname. The event in Ceilândia featured Lula and Leandro Grass, who highlighted federal government actions in the Federal District.

item.title: "Lula é o presidente do DF", diz Grass em ato do PT em Ceilândia
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT), candidate for GDF, spoke at an event in Ceilândia with Lula, highlighting projects such as the metro, University of Brasília and new campuses. Lula asked for votes for Grass during his speech.

item.title: Governo Lula rebate e diz que EUA ignora medidas do Brasil contra o crime organizado
item.description: The Brazilian government pushed back against U.S. criticism over its alleged failure to combat the PCC and Red Command, highlighting measures such as the Anti-Gang Law and joint security operations. The Trump administration labeled the gangs as terrorists and accused Brazil of negligence, but Brasília emphasized international cooperation and sovereignty in security actions. President Lula seeks to maintain alignment with Washington despite disagreements on security strategies.

item.title: Lula diz que país não comporta político vira-lata que fica de 4 para os EUA
item.description: Lula stated, at an event in Ceilândia, that Brazil does not tolerate politicians who side with the US over national sovereignty, specifically calling Eduardo Bolsonaro a traitor. He also announced plans to travel to the US for the UN and discuss non-interference in Brazilian elections with Trump.

item.title: Em Ceilândia, apoiadores deixam ato de Lula antes de discurso por chuva
item.description: Lula's supporters left the Ceilândia event before his speech due to rain and fatigue from waiting. The event, scheduled for 19:00, only started around 20:00 with the speech beginning at 21:10.

item.title: 'Não vamos deixar o povo sem dinheiro, mas não vamos dar dinheiro para o BRB', diz Lula em evento de campanha
item.description: Lula stated that the federal government will not fund the BRB, claiming the bank purchased non-existent titles and that the crisis was caused by the link between Ibaneis Rocha and Daniel Vorcaro. He strongly criticized DF Governor Celina Leão, accusing her of trying to shift responsibility for the Banco de Brasília collapse. In his first official campaign rally in the capital, the president reiterated the federal government's stance of not providing guarantees for resolving the issue.

item.title: 'De dia mostra a bandeira nacional e de noite vai ficar de quatro para os EUA', diz Lula sobre Eduardo e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula labeled Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro as flip-flopping politicians, accusing the expelled brother of plotting against Brazil in the US and pressuring Trump not to interfere in Brazilian elections.

item.title: Veja como foi a quarta-feira (16) dos presidenciáveis
item.description: On Wednesday (16), presidential candidates carried out campaign activities such as rallies, leafleting, and podcast interviews, focusing on topics like logistics infrastructure, sanitation, and education. Candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula, and Hertz Dias had public schedules, while others, such as Rui Costa Pimenta and Clariana Barão, did not disclose engagements.

item.title: Lula pede voto para Zé Dirceu à Câmara dos Deputados e fala em ‘reparação histórica’
item.description: President Lula recorded a video endorsing Zé Dirceu, a former minister convicted in the Mensalão case, calling for 'historical reparation'. He highlighted Dirceu's health struggles, mentioning his recovery from cancer, and reaffirmed PT's support for the candidate running for the Chamber of Deputies.

item.title: Janja critica bolsonarismo e afirma: “Não vamos voltar para as trevas”
item.description: Janja Lula da Silva criticized Bolsonarism during a PT event in Ceilândia, warning against social backsliding. She emphasized the need to avoid returning to governments that, she claims, led the country into "darkness" and cited Michelle Bolsonaro as an example of alignment with conservative ideas. The speech took place amid intensified electoral campaigning.

item.title: Vorcaro “comprou os dois lados da polarização”, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate, accused former banker Daniel Vorcaro of 'buying both sides of the polarization' in Brazil. Caiado claimed Vorcaro expects to be released if either Lula (PT) or Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) wins the election, implying he manipulated public opinion for personal gain. The statement was made on October 16th.

item.title: Governo instala conselho de minerais críticos e prepara 1ª reunião
item.description: President Lula established CIMCE, a council that will define Brazil's policy for critical and strategic minerals, with its first meeting scheduled within the next 10 days. The body includes representatives from 13 ministries and entities, and will have authority to assess strategic operations, ensuring national sovereignty over mineral resources. The creation of the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals and the FGAM, with R$2 billion from the federal government, strengthens government control over the sector.

item.title: Em resposta aos EUA, governo brasileiro nega falhas no combate ao crime organizado
item.description: The Brazilian government denied any failures in combating organized crime following U.S. accusations, citing measures such as the Anti-Gang Law and the Brazil Against Organized Crime Program.

item.title: OAB e entidades de juízes e de procuradores criticam fala de Dino sobre corrupção no Judiciário
item.description: The OAB, ANPR, and judicial entities criticized Minister Flávio Dino's remarks about corruption in the judiciary made during a session at the STF.

item.title: Pai de Vorcaro pede revogação da prisão e que Fachin destrave processo no STF
item.description: The defense of Henrique Vorcaro requests the revocation of preventive detention and asks Minister Edson Fachin to move forward with the cases at the STF. Henrique has been detained for over 90 days suspected of belonging to a violent nucleus linked to Daniel Vorcaro's criminal group. The processing of the Master and INSS cases was suspended while the Court defines jurisdiction and rapporteur.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral proíbe propaganda de André do Prado que usa imagem de Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo's electoral court banned the rerun of an André do Prado (PL) ad featuring Tarcísio's image, imposing a $10,000 fine per broadcast. The ruling aims to prevent misuse of another politician's image during free electoral airtime.

item.title: Lula diz que governo gastou R$ 47 bi para conter alta de combustíveis
item.description: President Lula stated in a podcast that the federal government allocated R$47 billion to curb gasoline and diesel price hikes, blaming inflationary pressure on the Iran conflict. He noted the funds could have funded other priorities and criticized foreign interventions, such as Trump's, for harming Brazil's economy.

item.title: TSE vai enviar alertas no e-Título com orientações para eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has begun sending notifications through the e-Título app to guide voters on electoral services and combat misinformation, providing details on polling locations and features such as certificates and fine payments. The free app replaces the physical voter ID and can serve as identification on election day for users with registered biometrics.

item.title: TSE proíbe candidato de utilizar imagem de Bolsonaro em santinhos
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha banned Lucas Bove's campaign, from PL, from using Jair Bolsonaro's image in campaign materials, enforcing a Supreme Court decision. The measure aims to prevent irregular political support, suspending the material's distribution until TSE plenary reviews the case.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que EUA não têm ‘moral’ para cobrar Brasil e defende bomba atômica nacional
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos criticized U.S. pressure on Brazil and advocated for developing a national atomic bomb as a matter of sovereignty.

item.title: Lula tenta se distanciar de Moraes, mas defende atuação do ministro no TSE
item.description: Lula claimed he did not appoint Moraes to the Supreme Court but praised his work at the TSE, amid tensions with the opposition over investigations in higher courts.

item.title: TRE-RJ indefere registro de candidatura de Cristiane Brasil e pede investigação contra o DC
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court rejected Cristiane Brasil's candidacy for the Chamber of Deputies due to alleged ties to a criminal organization and ordered an investigation into the Christian Democracy party for possible fraud. The ruling was issued without comment from the candidate or the party. The case remains under judicial review.

item.title: ‘Eduardo Bolsonaro é um lacaio de Trump’, diz Renan Santos em sabatina de VEJA
item.description: Renan Santos labeled Eduardo Bolsonaro as Trump's 'lackey' and deemed it dangerous for him to hold foreign policy roles. He criticizes US drug policy stance and polarization between Lula and Bolsonaro supporters.

item.title: 43% avaliam governo Lula como ruim ou péssimo, aponta Ipsos-Ipec
item.description: Ipsos-Ipec survey shows 43% of Brazilians rate the Lula government as bad or terrible, the highest disapproval since June 2025. Only 33% rate the management as great or good, while 23% consider it regular. The survey was conducted between April 9 and 13.

item.title: ‘Não acho que um homem mate mulher porque ela é uma mulher’, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, running under the Missão label, claimed that most femicide cases stem from abusive relationships, not gender-based hatred. He advocates for universal public policies, opposing gender quotas and identity-based measures, and rejects the criminalization of misogyny, warning of potential censorship and state overreach.

item.title: Ipsos/Ipec: 43% dos brasileiros avaliam o governo Lula como ruim ou péssimo
item.description: The September Ipsos-Ipec survey shows that 43% of Brazilians rate the Lula government as bad or terrible, an increase of five points since June. Distrust in the president also rose to 57%, while approval of public management remained stagnant.

item.title: "Dia deplorável”, diz Marina Silva sobre sessão do STF que julgou Moraes
item.description: Marina Silva described the STF session judging the Moraes case as 'deplorable,' criticizing justices' behavior and supporting Moraes' removal for investigation. She praised Cármen Lúcia for apologizing to society and noted the STF crisis shifted focus away from urgent issues like health and security.

item.title: Nova lei cria a Política Nacional de Minerais Críticos e Estratégicos
item.description: President Lula signed the law creating the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals, aimed at mineral sovereignty and promoting domestic processing. The legislation establishes the Mineral Activity Guarantee Fund with R$2 billion and includes mechanisms for sustainable exploitation of minerals essential to future technologies. Originating from PL 2780/24, the policy seeks to convert subsoil wealth into economic development and reduce reliance on raw material exports.

item.title: Renato Bolsonaro vê Jair disposto a participar de eventual governo de Flávio
item.description: Renato Bolsonaro said Jair Bolsonaro is willing to join Flávio Bolsonaro's potential government if he is elected. He made the statement after visiting Jair at his home detention, authorized by the STF.

item.title: PRF estabelece regras para evitar bloqueios nas eleições de 2026
item.description: The PRF and TSE issued a joint ordinance to restrict stops and prevent roadblocks that could hinder voter travel during the 2026 elections. The rules ban vehicle stops except in cases of concrete risk to life and require prior authorization from the regional electoral court for roadblocks, except in flagrante delict. The ordinance also complements the Electoral Code, which prohibits arrests of voters and candidates near election periods.

item.title: Padrinho de Moraes no STF, Temer se encontra com aliados de Mendonça em SP e busca atenuar crise
item.description: Former president Michel Temer met with allies of Minister André Mendonça in São Paulo to seek ways to reduce tensions between Alexandre de Moraes and Mendonça at the Supreme Court. The meeting aimed to lower the temperature between the two ministers.

item.title: ‘O diálogo acabou no momento em que a porta foi trancada’, diz Carlos Viana sobre Alcolumbre
item.description: Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) denounced the physical closure of the Senate plenary ordered by Davi Alcolumbre, accusing the measure of blocking debates on impeachment requests against STF ministers and suppressing criticism of the leadership. The senator called for Alcolumbre's removal and the involvement of the Ethics Council, stating that 'the dialogue ended when the door was locked'.

item.title: Liminar do TSE restabelece proibição de uso de imagem de Jair Bolsonaro em propaganda eleitoral
item.description: Minister Estela Aranha of the TSE granted an injunction reinstating the ban on using Jair Bolsonaro's image in the electoral campaign of Lucas Bove, a candidate for state representative in São Paulo, suspending the effects of a TRE-SP ruling. The decision is based on restrictions imposed on the former president by the STF, which prohibit political-electoral manifestations, even by third parties.

item.title: O que tem para fazer em Brasília? Confira programação de 17 a 22/9
item.description: Brasília offers various cultural and gastronomic activities from September 17 to 22, including festivals, book launches, and themed events. Highlights include the Nipo Festival 2026, featuring geek culture and Asian cuisine, and celebrations at the Oscarito complex. The program blends entertainment, culture, and flavors to enjoy the week.

item.title: Como redes sociais reagiram à 'sessão de guerra' no STF - e o que isso pode sinalizar para a eleição
item.description: Social media reacted intensely to the STF session, showing deep polarization and growing negative sentiment toward Alexandre de Moraes, while discussions about André Mendonça's judicial selectivity also rise. Central voters remain undecided, reflecting disappointment with politics. The case could influence the 2026 electoral dynamics.

item.title: Mendonça manda apagar vídeo de IA que ligava Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of an AI-generated video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Banco Master scandal, due to its potentially misleading photorealistic content. The video depicted the senator dancing in front of the bank's branding and involved in arrest scenes, alongside figures such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Fabiano Zettel. The ruling aims to prevent the spread of false information during the electoral process.

item.title: 'Não existe venda de sentença sem advogado comprando': OAB rebate fala de Dino e reclama de 'criminalização' da função
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) criticized Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino's remarks on sentence trading, accusing him of generalizations about the legal profession. In a statement signed by the Federal Council and 27 chapters, the entity argued that misconduct should be investigated individually, without holding the entire legal community accountable. The debate took place during a STF session addressing an investigation into minister Alexandre de Moraes for links with banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: TCU autoriza fiscalização de testes de integridade das urnas
item.description: The TCU authorized the monitoring of electronic voting machine integrity tests for the 2026 elections, involving all 27 regional electoral courts. The initiative aims to enhance transparency, auditability, and public trust in the Brazilian electoral system.

item.title: A má notícia da pesquisa Ipsos-Ipec para Lula a duas semanas do primeiro turno
item.description: The Ipsos-Ipec survey reveals that 43% of Brazilians consider Lula's administration bad or terrible, the worst performance since June 2025. Additionally, 53% disapprove of how Lula is governing, while 57% do not trust the president. Economic perception is also declining, with 45% stating the situation is worse than six months ago.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio aponta ganho de 8,7 milhões de seguidores nas redes em 1 ano
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL) highlighted an increase of 8.7 million social media followers between October 2025 and September 2026. The data, released based on the Fanpage Karma platform, indicates strong digital engagement for the campaign.

item.title: Deputado americano cita Moraes e pede ação da OEA sobre liberdade de expressão no Brasil
item.description: Republican Congressman Chris Smith urged the OAS to act on freedom of expression in Brazil, citing Minister Alexandre Moraes, and called for increased monitoring ahead of the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral barra candidatura de Cristiane Brasil, filha de Roberto Jefferson
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court rejected Cristiane Brasil's candidacy, daughter of Roberto Jefferson, due to suspected involvement in a criminal organization using a firearm. The decision is based on an investigation from Operation Catarata, which examined irregularities in contracts and fraud in social projects between 2013 and 2018. The candidate claims the evidence was annulled and only a Public Prosecutor's appeal remains under review.

item.title: Lula deve defender não interferência estrangeira em seu último discurso do mandato na ONU
item.description: Lula is expected to advocate for non-interference in domestic affairs during his speech at the 81st UN General Assembly, just before the first round of elections. The theme highlights the president's stance on national sovereignty in his final international address.

item.title: 'Flávio no STF', sugere Eduardo Bolsonaro, com montagem do irmão como ministro da Corte
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro proposed that his brother Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential candidate, take a seat at the STF. The suggestion was made in a social media post, amid the 2026 election race.
